fusions.name: Reaching Arm
fusions.desc: Reaches out a thread-wrapped arm that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Eightfold Loom
fusions.desc: Looses 8 threads at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Spare Arm
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
